componentStore.title: Component store
componentStore.todoDescription: Track what you need to do today
componentStore.todoDetail: Quick add, inline editing, important marks, completed collapsing and long-press drag sorting. Comes in 1×1, 2×2, 3×2 and 4×2 forms; at 1×1 it falls back to an app icon that opens the todo panel on click.
componentStore.clockDescription: Time, stopwatch and timer — multiple per screen
componentStore.clockDetail: Three types in one widget: time, stopwatch and timer. Pick a type when adding, and switch anytime via the gear. Time follows the global 12/24-hour and date settings; the stopwatch is precise to 0.01s with pause, resume and laps; the timer plays a looping alarm with a pulsing highlight until you stop it. Runtime state is persisted, so timing continues across reloads. Comes in 1×1, 2×2, 3×2 and 4×2 forms; at 1×1 it falls back to an app icon that opens a full-feature panel on click.
